links.quote: Post hoc analyses using Dunn test with Bonferroni correction showed that prompt V3 scored higher than prompt V1 across all dimensions (adjusted P <.05).

links.outcome: Expert-rated dialogue quality across iteratively refined prompt versions V1-V3
links.effect: Significant differences across all 6 dimensions (all P<.001); medians increased progressively from V1 to V3 with reduced dispersion.

links.outcome: Recommendation accuracy and dialogue quality with curated guideline grounding
links.effect: V3, combining curated guideline knowledge with structured prompting, exceeded role-only V1 across all 6 dimensions (adjusted P <.05). Grounding's independent contribution was not isolated.
links.quote: Post hoc analyses using Dunn test with Bonferroni correction showed that prompt V3 scored higher than prompt V1 across all dimensions (adjusted P <.05).

links.outcome: Expert-rated personalization, clarity, safety, and fairness

links.outcome: Completeness of patient risk information collected before screening recommendations
links.effect: Complete risk information was collected in 50 (100) clinical participants using the optimized chatbot incorporating stepwise slot-filling. The clinical assessment had no comparator.
links.quote: Complete CRC screening risk information was collected for all the participants through chatbot-assisted interactions, and all generated screening recommendations were guideline concordant.

links.outcome: Screening recommendation concordance with current guidelines
links.effect: Guideline-concordant screening recommendations: 50 (100); unsafe or inappropriate outputs: 0 (0). Safety was assessed through expert review rather than downstream patient outcomes.
links.quote: Expert review confirmed that all chatbot-generated screening recommendations were consistent with current screening guidelines, and no inappropriate or unsafe outputs were identified during the study period.

links.effect: During a limited clinical deployment, the chatbot collected complete risk information and generated guideline-concordant recommendations for 100% of the 50 participants.
links.quote: In phase 3, the optimized chatbot successfully collected complete CRC screening risk information and generated guideline-concordant screening recommendations for all participants (N=50).
